title: Copse feature-pack manifest
description: The declarative manifest for a Copse feature pack. A pack bundles a feature via slots (tools/hooks/prompt/ui/settings/storage) on top of the plugin.json shape Copse already loads (name/version/description/skills/mcpServers). First-party and user packs share this manifest (decision 15); first-party packs additionally supply typed runtime contributions (native tools, in-process function hooks, real renderer views) that are defined in code, not on disk. See docs/packs.md and docs/plans/hooks-and-feature-packs.md (P1).

name.description: Pack id / name (plugin.json `name`). Also the grouping key across all slots.

description.description: Human description shown in the Settings pack list (P3).

trust.description: Whether the pack is shipped by Copse or user-installed (decision 15). A discovered plugin.json is always `user`; first-party packs declare `first-party` in code.

skills.description: Existing plugin.json slot: relative path to a skills directory.

tools.description: Tools slot: native tool names (first-party) contributed to the model tool list, or an MCP config file path (user packs).

native.description: Native tool names added to the model tool list while enabled (first-party).

acpTools.description: Subset of native tools safe to offer to external ACP agents through Copse's authenticated localhost bridge (first-party only).

mcpServers.description: Path to an MCP config file (user packs), like the plugin.json `mcpServers` field.

hooks.description: Command-hook declarations (user packs). First-party function hooks are typed runtime contributions defined in code, not declared here (decision 15).

event.description: Canonical event name the hook subscribes to.

command.description: Shell command spawned when the event fires.

prompt.description: Prompt / steering blocks folded into assembly while enabled, each with trust framing.

trust.description: A `trusted` (first-party) block is injected verbatim; an `untrusted` (user) block is delimited as data.

ui.description: UI contributions. Level 1 = declarative cards, level 2 = a named panel slot fed structured data, level 3 = a real renderer view (first-party).

slot.description: Named host slot this mounts into (level 2/3); omitted for level-1 cards.

title.description: Human title for the Settings pack-list enumeration (P3).

panel.description: Level-2 refinement (P2). Declares the panel shape the pack emits so the host can validate incoming panel_update payloads. Required when level = 2; the host rejects a level-2 contribution without a panel decl.

kind.description: Data shape: a flat ordered list (ACP plan–shaped) or a nested tree.

header.description: Human header rendered above the panel; falls back to the contribution `title`.

ariaLabel.description: Optional a11y label; defaults to `header` / contribution `title`.

capabilities.description: Named runtime capability flags the pack owns — pure cross-cutting behaviour (no tool/hook/prompt/panel), read by any subsystem through the registry's isCapabilityActive seam and enumerated in Settings (P3).

name.description: Stable capability id subsystems read via isCapabilityActive.

title.description: Human title for the Settings pack-list enumeration.

description.description: Optional human description shown alongside the title.

permissions.description: Permission / sandbox relaxations the pack DECLARES it may request (issue #1190) — the authority it opens. The permission-gate only grants a declared relaxation while the owning pack is enabled; disabling the pack revokes it atomically. Enumerated in Settings and exposed for the install-time capability/permission review (#1082).

name.description: Stable relaxation id the permission-gate resolves via isPermissionDeclared.

title.description: Human title for the Settings pack-list enumeration.

description.description: Optional human description of the authority the relaxation opens.

scope.description: Granularity of the permission grant that gates the relaxation (defaults to project).

settings.description: Pack-scoped settings schema, keyed by setting id, rendered generically in Settings (P3).

default.description: Default value. For a `model` field this is an optional default model id (string).

options.description: Allowed values for an `enum` field. A `model` field takes no static options — its list is the live model catalogue resolved host-side at read time.

storage.description: Namespaced storage declaration. Pack state persists across disable, like a disabled browser extension's data (decision 17).
